newsitem.title: USA: CBOT extends trading hours in Project A financials.
newsitem.headline: CBOT extends trading hours in Project A financials.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade extended the closing time for financial contracts on its Project A overnight electronic trading system to 0645 CST/1245 GMT, from 0600 CST/1200 GMT, the CBOT said.
Project A begins trading financial products at 2200 CST/0400 GMT on Mondays through Fridays.
The extended trading hours, which were approved by the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, will begin with the overnight session on Thursday, January 16.

The CBOT said the revised schedule will remain in effect pending the CBOT's linkage with the London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange on May 9, 1997. ((Derivatives desk, 312-408-8750;E-mail derivatives@reuters.com))
